description: Look up PubMed IDs from partial bibliographic citations. Useful when you have a reference (journal, year, volume, page, author) and need the PMID — deterministic citation matching, more reliable than free-text search for structured references. Each citation must include at least journal or a four-digit year (ECitMatch primary-keys on journal+volume+page; author-only or volume-only inputs guarantee no match); more fields = better match accuracy.

citations.description: Citations to look up, 1–25, each matched independently. More fields = better match accuracy.

items.description: Citation to match against PubMed. Must include at least journal or a four-digit year — ECitMatch primary-keys on journal+volume+page, so author-only or volume-only inputs guarantee no match.

authorName.description: Author name, typically "lastname initials" (e.g., "mann bj"). Must contain a visible character, and cannot contain a pipe ("|") or a line break.

firstPage.description: First page number. Must contain a visible character, and cannot contain a pipe ("|") or a line break.

journal.description: Journal title or ISO abbreviation (e.g., "proc natl acad sci u s a"). Must contain a visible character, and cannot contain a pipe ("|") or a line break.

key.description: Arbitrary label to track this citation in results. Auto-assigned if omitted. Echoed back unchanged and never sent to NCBI, so any character is accepted here.

volume.description: Volume number. Must contain a visible character, and cannot contain a pipe ("|") or a line break.

name: pubmed_lookup_citation

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `queue_full`: The local NCBI request queue shed the call — the queue is full, or the call cannot start before its total deadline (for example behind the cooldown that follows an NCBI 429). `ncbi_unreachable`: NCBI E-utilities failed on every attempt the retry budget allowed — retries ran out, or the next backoff would overrun the total deadline. `ncbi_rate_limited`: NCBI answered HTTP 429 (too many requests) and the call stopped on it — retries ran out, the next backoff would overrun the total deadline, or the Retry-After NCBI named outlasts the time left or the 30-second backoff cap. `ncbi_deadline_exceeded`: The total NCBI request deadline expired before NCBI answered successfully — mid-request, while queued, or during a retry backoff. `ncbi_invalid_response`: NCBI returned a body that could not be parsed (invalid XML/JSON). `ncbi_resource_not_found`: NCBI returned a structured "not found" error for the requested ID(s). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

results.description: Match results, one per input citation

candidatePmids.description: Candidate PMIDs returned when the citation matched ambiguously. Add more bibliographic fields and retry to disambiguate, or fetch each candidate via pubmed_fetch_articles to pick the intended one.

detail.description: Additional detail returned by ECitMatch for non-exact matches

matchedFirstAuthor.description: First author of the matched article (e.g., "Husain M"). Useful eyeball signal for verifying a match.

status.description: Lookup outcome classification for this citation

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings about this match. A PMID may be returned even when the queried author or year disagrees with the matched article — verify before treating the PMID as authoritative.

totalMatched.description: Number of citations with PMID matches

totalWarnings.description: Number of matched citations that carry at least one warning

title: Pubmed Lookup Citation
